description: Source code for a Dining Philosophers demo demonstrating multi-thread synchronization with configurable object types, thread priorities, and static/dynamic objects in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: set_phil_state_pos
methods.description: Sets cursor position for philosopher state display.

methods.name: print_phil_state
methods.description: Prints the current state of a philosopher with optional delay.

methods.name: get_random_delay
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random delay based on philosopher ID and uptime.

methods.name: is_last_philosopher
methods.description: Checks if the philosopher is the last in the sequence.

methods.name: philosopher
methods.description: Main thread function simulating philosopher behavior: thinking and eating with forks.

methods.name: new_prio
methods.description: Determines thread priority based on philosopher index and configuration.

methods.name: init_objects
methods.description: Initializes fork objects if static objects are not used.

methods.name: start_threads
methods.description: Creates and starts philosopher threads with appropriate priorities and access rights.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point that initializes and starts the demo, with optional coverage and timeslicing settings.
